title: Plane of Tanks
statementMd:
Vasya plays the Plane of Tanks. The tanks in this game keep trying to finish each other off. But your "Pedalny" is not like that... He just needs to drive in a straight line from point $*A*$ to point B on the plane. Unfortunately, on the same plane are $*n*$ enemy tanks. We shall regard all the tanks as points. At the initial moment of time Pedalny is at the point $*A*$. Enemy tanks would be happy to destroy it immediately, but initially their turrets are tuned in other directions. Specifically, for each tank we know the initial rotation of the turret $*a*_{*i*}$ (the angle in radians relative to the $*OX*$ axis in the counterclockwise direction) and the maximum speed of rotation of the turret $*w*_{*i*}$ (radians per second). If at any point of time a tank turret will be aimed precisely at the tank Pedalny, then the enemy fires and it never misses. Pedalny can endure no more than $*k*$ shots. Gun reloading takes very much time, so we can assume that every enemy will produce no more than one shot. Your task is to determine what minimum speed of $*v*$ Pedalny must have to get to the point $*B*$. It is believed that Pedalny is able to instantly develop the speed of $*v*$, and the first $*k*$ shots at him do not reduce the speed and do not change the coordinates of the tank.

## Input

The first line contains 4 numbers – the coordinates of points $*A*$ and $*B*$ (in meters), the points do not coincide. On the second line number $*n*$ is given ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{4}$). It is the number of enemy tanks. Each of the following $*n*$ lines contain the coordinates of a corresponding tank $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$ and its parameters $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*w*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 2π$, $0 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 100$). Numbers $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*w*_{*i*}$ contain at most 5 digits after the decimal point. All coordinates are integers and their absolute values do not exceed $10^{5}$. Enemy tanks can rotate a turret in the clockwise as well as in the counterclockwise direction at the angular speed of not more than $*w*_{*i*}$. It is guaranteed that each of the enemy tanks will need at least $0.1$ seconds to aim at any point of the segment $*AB*$ and each of the enemy tanks is posistioned no closer than $0.1$ meters to line $*AB*$. On the last line is given the number $*k*$ ($0 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$).

## Output

Print a single number with absolute or relative error no more than $10^{ - 4}$ — the minimum required speed of Pedalny in meters per second.
statementZhMd:
瓦夏正在玩《坦克平面》。这款游戏中的坦克总是试图消灭彼此。但你的“Pedalny”可不是这样……它只需要在平面上沿直线从点 $*A*$ 行驶到点 B。不幸的是，同一平面上还有 $*n*$ 辆敌方坦克。我们将所有坦克视为点。在初始时刻，Pedalny 位于点 $*A*$。敌方坦克本想立即摧毁它，但它们的炮塔起初都朝向其他方向。具体来说，对于每辆坦克，我们知道其炮塔的初始旋转角 $*a*_{*i*}$（相对于 $*OX*$ 轴按逆时针方向测量，单位为弧度）以及炮塔的最大旋转速度 $*w*_{*i*}$（单位为弧度/秒）。如果在任意时刻，某辆坦克的炮塔恰好瞄准了 Pedalny，那么敌人就会开火，并且绝不会射偏。Pedalny 最多能够承受 $*k*$ 次射击。由于火炮重新装填需要很长时间，因此可以认为每个敌人最多开火一次。你的任务是确定 Pedalny 到达点 $*B*$ 所需的最小速度 $*v*$。可以认为 Pedalny 能够瞬间达到速度 $*v*$，并且最初的 $*k*$ 次射击不会降低其速度，也不会改变坦克的位置。

## 输入格式

第一行包含 4 个数——点 $*A*$ 和 $*B*$ 的坐标（单位：米），两点不重合。第二行给出数字 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{4}$），表示敌方坦克的数量。接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含一辆对应坦克的坐标 $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$ 以及其参数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*w*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 2π$, $0 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 100$）。数字 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*w*_{*i*}$ 的小数部分最多包含 5 位。所有坐标均为整数，且其绝对值不超过 $10^{5}$。敌方坦克可以顺时针或逆时针旋转炮塔，角速度不超过 $*w*_{*i*}$。保证每辆敌方坦克瞄准线段 $*AB*$ 上的任意点都至少需要 0.1 秒，并且每辆敌方坦克到直线 $*AB*$ 的距离不小于 0.1 米。最后一行给出数字 $*k*$（$0 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个数，表示 Pedalny 所需的最小速度，单位为米/秒。绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 4}$。
